question:
Read the below statements marked as Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Mark the correct option:

Assertion (A): The SVAMITVA scheme issues property cards using drone-based mapping.

Reason (R): The scheme is implemented in both rural and urban areas.

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true

solution:
The Correct answer is __**A is true, but R is false**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **SVAMITVA scheme** stands for **Survey of Villages and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas**.
 
• The scheme aims to provide **property cards** to rural households, enabling them to access loans and other financial benefits.
 
• **Drone-based mapping** technology is used to map properties and land parcels in rural areas for issuing property cards.
 
• The scheme is specifically designed to benefit people in **rural areas**, and it does not extend to **urban areas**.
 
• It is implemented by the **Ministry of Panchayati Raj** under the Government of India.
 
• The scheme helps in reducing disputes related to property ownership in rural regions and provides a **legal document** for ownership.
 
• The property cards issued under this scheme can be used as **collateral for loans**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Explanation of Incorrect Options:**__

 __
 
• The **Reason (R)** is incorrect because the SVAMITVA scheme is implemented **only in rural areas**, not in urban areas. The assertion correctly mentions the use of **drone-based mapping**, but the reason provides an inaccurate context.
 
 
 
• **Other Important Points:**__
 
 
• The scheme was launched on **24th April 2020**, which is celebrated as **National Panchayati Raj Day**.
 
• It aims to cover approximately **6.62 lakh villages** across India.
 
• The scheme also helps in creating **accurate land records** for better revenue collection and planning.
 
• It is a part of the Government of India's efforts towards **Digital India** and **Atmanirbhar Bharat**.
